column1: # NGE V1.26 — English review skeletons (design §4, Appendix B)
# skeleton: pipe-separated slot list; "slot?P" includes the slot with probability P.
# Slots resolve from phrases_en.tsv; micro-slots inside fragments ({title},
# {platform}, {price}, …) are filled by the engine from real data or sub-slots.
# sentiment: pos | mixed | neg (engine maps the blended reception score to one).
